summary: Retest of Import flow on web preview after fix in /app/frontend/src/services/fs.ts (readFileText now uses fetch(uri).text() on web). RESULT: Import flow is now fully working end-to-end on web. 1) Pilih File JSON (btn-pick) correctly opens the file chooser and after selecting the rockstar backup JSON, the import-preview card renders with correct counts: Team=5, Products=7, Monthly Targets=0, Legacy Targets=9, Closings=104 (118 items), Daily Production=255, COED=12, Cancellation=12, Settings=3. 2) btn-apply with mode-merge succeeds; Riwayat (import log) records 'Rockstar_old · Merge'. 3) Dashboard Agustus 2026 shows non-zero KPIs: Dues Gross Rp42.7jt, Dues Achievement Rp41.2jt, Private Gross Rp25.9jt, Dues Unit 32, Funnel leads=111/appt=122/show=78/interview=83, and all 5 member cards (Emily Manager, Cipta ASM, Matt/Eric/Liam SA) show non-zero Dues/Private/Achievement figures. Oktober 2026 correctly shows Rp0 KPIs with funnel leads=4 (backup ends 3 Oct). 4) Re-importing the SAME file with Merge: preview #2 correctly displays 'Duplikat terdeteksi: 104 closing, 255 production, 12 COED, 12 cancellation (akan dilewati saat Merge)' and after apply the Oct 2026 totals remain Rp0 (not doubled), confirming dedupe is functional. The previously critical readFileText-on-web bug is resolved. Pre-existing React Native web warnings (shadow* deprecation, props.pointerEvents deprecation, useNativeDriver fallback) remain and are documented from iteration_1.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' Carried over from iteration_1. Low priority; migrate shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius to boxShadow in shared components (Card/Button/FAB).
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Carried over from iteration_1. Likely inside modal/overlay components.

action_items: No blocking issues. Optional: migrate 'shadow*' style props to 'boxShadow' and move 'pointerEvents' prop into style on web overlays to silence console warnings.

src/services/importer.ts preview() and applyImport() dedupe logic is confirmed functional via preview #2 showing 104/255/12/12 duplicates on re-import and Oct 2026 totals remaining unchanged.
